pictures.name: empty_water_jar_in_the_sun
pictures.scene: a clay water jar standing quite empty and dry in hard sunlight on bare ground, the jar lit warm and hard at the bottom of the frame, the parched ground and pale sky above it flat and colourless

pictures.name: still_horizon_watched_at_dawn
pictures.scene: a long empty horizon under the first grey of dawn with nothing moving anywhere upon it, the near ground lit faintly warm at the bottom of the frame, the wide pale sky above it quiet and waiting

pictures.name: haze_hiding_the_far_hills
pictures.scene: thick pale haze swallowing a range of hills so that only the nearest slope can be made out, the near grass lit warm and low, the whole distance above it blank and white and holding no detail

pictures.name: unopened_door_at_the_end_of_a_hall
pictures.scene: a heavy shut door standing at the far end of a long dim hall, the near paving lit warm and low at the bottom of the frame, the corridor and the closed door above it deep and shadowed and silent

pictures.name: shrivelled_wineskin_above_a_hearth
pictures.scene: an old leather wineskin hung above a hearth and gone dark and shrunken and stiff with smoke, the skin lit warm and low at the bottom of the frame, the sooty wall above it dim and brown and bare

pictures.name: long_shadow_creeping_across_a_floor
pictures.scene: one long slow shadow reaching most of the way across a stone floor as the day wears on, the sunlit strip of floor warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the shaded wall above it dim and still

pictures.name: covered_pit_in_a_field_path
pictures.scene: a deep pit dug in a field path and hidden under loose brush and scattered earth, the disturbed ground lit hard and warm at the bottom of the frame, the field beyond it flat and pale and innocent

pictures.name: stone_wall_true_after_long_years
pictures.scene: a very old stone wall still standing perfectly straight and level after long weathering, the nearest course lit warm and hard at the bottom of the frame, the wall above it plain and grey and sound

pictures.name: stones_heaped_against_a_shut_door
pictures.scene: a heap of rough stones piled up hard against a closed timber door, the nearest stones lit hard and warm at the bottom of the frame, the blocked door and wall above them dim and plain and shut

pictures.name: last_ember_still_glowing_in_ash
pictures.scene: one small ember still glowing deep in a wide bed of grey ash, the ember lit warm and red at the bottom of the frame, the cold ash and the dark air above it dim and even and almost out

pictures.name: rain_soaking_into_dry_ground
pictures.scene: steady rain sinking into dry cracked ground and darkening it right through, the wet earth lit warm and clear at the bottom of the frame, the falling rain and grey sky above it soft and full

pictures.name: spring_running_full_at_morning
pictures.scene: a spring running strong and full out of a hillside in clean morning light, the moving water lit warm and bright at the bottom of the frame, the green slope and sky above it soft and pale and calm

lines.text: My soul faints for Your salvation;
My eyes fail, looking for Your promise;
I ask, “When will You comfort me?”
Though I am like a wineskin dried up by smoke,
I do not forget Your statutes.
How many days must Your servant wait?
When will You execute judgment on my persecutors?
The arrogant have dug pits for me
I am persecuted without cause—help me!
They almost wiped me from the earth,
but I have not forsaken Your precepts.
Revive me according to Your loving devotion,
that I may obey the testimony of Your mouth.
